commit_message: Align documentation after public repository cutover
pr_title: Align GameEngine docs with the public repository cutover
pr_body:
## Summary

Aligns repository guidance and migration records with the completed public cutover.

- distinguishes the three-command local core gate from Windows full validation
- corrects affected-mode planner and Clippy documentation to match implementation
- updates canonical documentation paths for the standalone repository root
- records the completed public cutover and the pending legacy private automation retirement in RustProject PR #72
- marks the old OSS staging/publication-boundary instructions as historical while preserving unfinished licensing/release work

This is documentation-only and does not change product behavior or trusted workflow files.
